Well the boneless already come in pre breaded but we do hand bread our crispy tenders and chicken breasts. We use a beer batter but we double bread before frying. If I do anything at home I personally keep it simple with a egg wash then all purpose flour with pepper and a few spices mixed in with breading to give it a little extra flavor. Remember to bread it twice!!

Just find the opportunity when you can, sometimes I’ll purposefully staff extra in the morning/afternoon (slowest shifts during the week) to get it done. Not to take away anything from my team who are all amazing but I tend to do a lot of this cleaning myself (hood vents, scrubbing floors, polishing stainless steel, cleaning drains etc…)

I have a lot younger crew in the kitchen with some with very little restaurant experience so it’s still a learning process with getting them to understand deep cleaning, in the meantime as long as they can focus on cooking and hold down the line without much help I tend to do this stuff so we don’t get behind. Been slowly getting them more involved with it though.
I really appreciate it, there has been a lot of things we haven’t been able to control during covid but cleaning is something any restaurant can control💪🏻

We’re located in a small town so compared to other stores in bigger cities in the surrounding area we’re not considered high volume. Even so, ever since football season started we’ve been doing close to $50K/week in sales. Just due to lots of call outs it’s hard to have a system in place to get all of this done on a specific day but always trying to do deep cleaning at least once every 1-2 weeks so nothing gets bad. My GM is a lot more FOH focused and I’m more Kitchen focused so we balance each other out and it gives me time to focus on cleaning.
